configurePresets.name: release

configurePresets.name: fast
configurePresets.displayName: macOS fast build: upstream clang + shared PCH with codegen
configurePresets.description: Homebrew LLVM (brew install llvm). mayag.hpp is precompiled once with its code compiled once; ~115 s cold on an 8-core M-series, 9 s to rebuild one example.

configurePresets.name: quick
configurePresets.displayName: macOS edit-test loop: upstream clang -O1 + shared PCH + ccache
configurePresets.description: What to build while changing mayag. Measured on this M-series at -j12 (utility QoS): 166 s cold for everything (examples + tests) against 323 s for 'fast' (-O3); a widget-header change rebuilds in 19 s (Apple clang -O3, no shared PCH: 41 s). All 82 tests pass, and run in 27 s. -O1 still defines __OPTIMIZE__, so the timing gates stay enforced. Use 'fast' for benchmarks.
